sources.title: Flex 2.5G - Tech Specs
sources.evidence_note: Official 8x2.5 GbE RJ45 ports, 1x10 GbE RJ45 port, 1x10G SFP+ port, no PoE output, 14 W maximum consumption, USB Type-C 5 V 3 A input, PoE+ input and external 15 W AC/DC adapter. No combo relationship is asserted.
